Verifies that {@code substitutor} performs no substitution on {@code replaceTemplate}.

When {@code replaceTemplate} is {@code null}, every {@code replace}/{@code replaceIn} overload is exercised to confirm null inputs are handled (returning {@code null} or {@code false}). Otherwise, the template is expected to pass through both {@code replace(String)} and {@code replaceIn(TextStringBuilder)} unchanged.

Verifies that {@code substitutor} substitutes {@code replaceTemplate} into {@code expectedResult} consistently across every input type accepted by {@link StringSubstitutor}.

The same template is fed through each {@code replace(...)} overload (String, char[], StringBuffer, StringBuilder, TextStringBuilder and Object) and each in-place {@code replaceIn(...)} overload, asserting the same result every time.

When {@code substring} is {@code true}, the template is also processed with offset/length arguments that skip the first and last characters. {@code expectedShortResult} is the expected output of that partial substitution; note that the in-place {@code replaceIn(..., offset, length)} variants still yield the full result because the skipped remainder is left untouched.
